what: A Casio MT-40 clone inside the FM-1: its six 1981 auto-accompaniment rhythms, including ROCK, the preset that became the Sleng Teng riddim (82 BPM, 1985). Four drum lanes, a bass that transposes with the one-key chord, FILL, A/B variation, MPC swing; Felucca engines stay playable on top.
author: Altess Production
